abilities.text: Turning undead uses the class table and a 2d6 result; a successful result affects 2d6 hit dice, with at least one creature affected.
Eligible to establish a stronghold; religious support, followers, and obligations are adjudicated by the DM.
Infravision: 60 feet. Detect underground slopes, traps, moving walls, or recent construction on 1-2 on d6 while searching.
Eligible to establish an underground stronghold.
Infravision: 60 feet. Find secret or hidden doors on 1-2 on d6 while searching. Immune to ghoul paralysis.
Eligible to establish a woodland stronghold; local animal assistance depends on its completion and the DM.
Eligible to establish a castle and become a landed ruler.
Hiding: 90% outdoors in cover; 1-2 on d6 in dungeon shadows while remaining silent and motionless.
May establish a stronghold when resources and circumstances permit.
May undertake magical item research; process and costs require DM adjudication.
May establish a tower and attract 1d6 apprentices of levels 1-3.
Backstab: attack from behind while unnoticed grants +4 to hit and doubles normal damage.
Read nonmagical languages with 80% success. A failed text can be retried after gaining a level.
May establish a hideout and attract 2d6 first-level thief followers.
Can use magic-user scrolls, with a 10% chance that the spell has the opposite effect.
